_comment: Optional deployment release proposal. Set a new semantic version and notes before deploying; Avenue Guard will DM the configured owner and publish it only after approval. Leave version blank when no automatic proposal is needed.
title: Public Level Recommendations
summary: Adds permanent public recommendation pages, exact send-tier artwork and a more resilient Geometry Dash validation path
changes: Added permanent gdavenue.netlify.app/level/[level-id] recommendation pages with live queue information
Added LevelThumbs artwork with a clean solid-black fallback when no thumbnail is available
Cropped the five supplied Rate through Mythic faces exactly and wired configurable Discord application emoji IDs
Reworked accepted and reviewer embeds with concise outreach wording, reviewer attribution and public level links
Added GDRate+ as the default hosted fallback and corrected direct Boomlings requests for current Geometry Dash responses
Disabled GDBrowser by default because hosted Cloudflare access is unreliable and its API is not recommended for dependency
Removed automatic expired-validation card refreshes while preserving inline request ages and manual Recheck controls
Added privacy-filtered public level API coverage and full provider, message, restart and responsive-page regression tests
